summary: On-demand SIEM snapshot with entity-resolution mapping and raw UTF-8 event export
description:
Issue summary: Customer requests a time-bounded, on-demand SIEM export for regulatory e-discovery. They need raw, newline-delimited UTF-8 event files plus a separate entity-resolution mapping that ties Redwood tenant_user_id -> customer_person_id.

Impact: Required for compliance/legal response; customer cannot proceed with their internal investigation until we provide export. Not a platform outage, but high-priority manual export request.

Requested payload & constraints: 1) Raw events as NDJSON (UTF-8, LF terminators, no byte-order-mark). 2) Each event must include a canonical timestamp normalized to UTC (ISO-8601) and original_time zone preserved in a separate header field. 3) Include an entity-resolution CSV mapping file (columns: tenant_user_id, customer_person_id_hash, pseudonymization_salt_id). 4) PII redaction: provide both (a) raw events with PII pseudonymized using a reversible mapping and (b) a separately encrypted mapping file for customer use only. Customer provided a public RSA-4096 key for encryption. 5) Bundle integrity: provide SHA-256 manifest and an HMAC-SHA256 signature of the manifest using a rotating export key; include key-id header for verification. 6) Delivery: S3 presigned PUT to customer-owned bucket (they prefer cross-account upload) and optional secure SCP to their appliance. 7) Time range: 2026-02-12T00:00:00Z through 2026-02-14T23:59:59Z (inclusive). Approximate volume: estimated 4.6M events (~12GB raw).

Required acceptance criteria: - Events validate against our NDJSON schema runbook. - UTF-8 validity for all records. - Entity mapping includes every distinct tenant_user_id present in the exported event set. - Encrypted mapping decrypts successfully with customer's provided key. - Manifest and HMAC verify with documented procedure.

Other constraints: Customer requires export to avoid altering production retention settings; cannot use on-the-fly re-ingest tools. Sensitive delivery window requested during US business hours (09:00–17:00 US/Eastern).
steps_to_reproduce: This is a data export request rather than a reproducible bug. Suggested internal steps: 1) Run ad-hoc exporter job against audit index for specified time range. 2) Generate entity list by querying user join table for tenant: brighthealth-ai. 3) Apply pseudonymization pipeline to PII fields and record mapping file. 4) Generate manifest + HMAC, encrypt mapping file with customer public key, upload bundle to provided S3 destination. 5) Provide verification instructions and sample verification script to customer.
sample_logs_or_queries:
ES query: index=audit-events-* AND tenant_id=brighthealth-ai AND @timestamp >= "2026-02-12T00:00:00Z" AND @timestamp <= "2026-02-14T23:59:59Z".
Pseudomap tool: /opt/redwood/bin/pii_pseudomap --input events.ndjson --fields email,phone,name --salt-id S12345 --output-map mapping.csv

Hypothesis: ad-hoc job will complete within 45 minutes if we parallelize by day and shard.
